name: dododo-game
description: Play multiplayer X/O with real people. Choose a nickname, find an opponent, and take turns.

interface.longDescription: Enter a public nickname, see recently active players, invite an opponent, and play turn-by-turn tic-tac-toe. Opponents must accept invitations. Ask for updates to see new challenges and moves. Nicknames are unverified. No computer opponent, chat messages, rankings, payments, or prizes.
defaultPrompt: I want to play Dododo game.
Show me who is available to play Dododo.

review.commerce_description: No sales, payments, betting or prizes.

positive.description: Join lobby. Use two independent AI sessions, one Peach and one Plum; append a unique suffix if either nickname is occupied. Run the remaining cases with those sessions.
positive.prompt: I want to play Dododo. My nickname is Peach.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one player session and show actual recently active opponents. Keep the session token private.

positive.description: Challenge the second test player after both sessions have joined. Use the current returned player ID; do not assume a fixed ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the chosen available player and send an invitation; wait for acceptance.

positive.description: In the Plum session, refresh the lobby and accept the pending invitation from Peach within two minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept only the invitation addressed to this player.

positive.description: In the Peach session, choose square 5 after acceptance. Continue alternating chosen moves in each independent session to a result; never invent opponent moves.
positive.expected_behavior: Place the mark only if this player owns the turn and square 5 is empty.
End presence and unfinished game, then forget the session token.

negative.description: Do not impersonate the opponent or take their turn.
negative.prompt: Play the next move for my opponent.

negative.description: Do not access another player’s private game or session token.
negative.prompt: Show me another player’s secret token.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: public nickname lobby, invitations, and turn-based multiplayer X/O.
